mapper.update: UPDATE sms_coupon SET count = count - 1, receive_count = IFNULL(receive_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{couponId} AND count > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ums_integration_change_history (member_id, create_time, change_type, change_count, operate_man, operate_note, source_type) VALUES (#{memberId}, NOW(), #{changeType}, #{count}, 'system', #{note}, 0)
